// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// A bare side-effect import preceded on the same line by a block comment that
// closes there.
//
// The anchor for the bare form is a statement position, not a word boundary.
// `/* … */` had to be an explicit alternation in it, and this fixture is the
// reason: without it the form below is invisible and an ops file could pull in
// an off-allowlist module in silence.
//
// It must be `\*\/` and NOT a bare `/` added to the character class. A bare `/`
// would make the second slash of a `//` comment a valid prefix, so a line like
//     // import "@/lib/mailer" is deliberately absent here
// would be read as a real import — which is one of the ten prose false
// positives the anchoring exists to remove. Narrowing and widening in the same
// character is how a fix undoes itself.
/* set up */ import "@/lib/mailer";

export async function stillNotAnImportOfAnythingAllowed() {
  return true;
}
